scripts.start:dev: npm run db:prepare && concurrently -n dotnet,client "dotnet run --project dotnet-services/ADF247.Api" "npm run start --prefix client"
scripts.start:pro: npm run db:prepare && npm run build --prefix client && dotnet run --configuration Release --project dotnet-services/ADF247.Api
scripts.test: dotnet build dotnet-services/ADF247.slnx --nologo && npm run test:ci --prefix client
